setup: Build the same invalid workflow through TryBuild and Build.
assertion: TryBuild returns the complete ordered WorkflowDiagnostic set and Build throws WorkflowDefinitionException with the identical diagnostics.
expectedRed: The exact staged completion builders and diagnostic exception contract do not exist.

setup: Call EphemeralWorkflowBuilder.End with a null WorkflowOutcomeName.
assertion: The call eagerly throws ArgumentNullException before graph mutation.
expectedRed: The exact End overload is absent.

setup: Call both EphemeralWorkflowBuilder resultful End overloads with a null output selector.
assertion: Each call eagerly throws ArgumentNullException before graph mutation.
expectedRed: The exact resultful End overloads are absent.

setup: Call DurableWorkflowBuilder.End with a null WorkflowOutcomeName.
assertion: The call eagerly throws ArgumentNullException before graph mutation.
expectedRed: The exact End overload is absent.

setup: Call both DurableWorkflowBuilder resultful End overloads with a null output selector.
assertion: Each call eagerly throws ArgumentNullException before graph mutation.
expectedRed: The exact resultful End overloads are absent.

setup: Author an empty root Parallel scope in each mode and invoke TryBuild and Build.
assertion: Both modes report SFE-AUTH-BRANCH-004 with Build/TryBuild diagnostic parity.
expectedRed: The exact root Parallel scope families are absent.

setup: Call DurableWorkflowBuilder.ContinueAsNew with a non-null replacement selector.
assertion: It returns DurableWorkflowCompletionBuilder and exposes no further authoring members.
expectedRed: ContinueAsNew still has a provisional shape.

setup: Apply retry, step timeout, or transient-pool decoration twice or without an eligible preceding ephemeral step.
assertion: The misuse eagerly throws WorkflowDefinitionException containing only SFE-AUTH-DECORATOR-001.

setup: Call CompleteWithin twice on one workflow.
assertion: The second call eagerly throws WorkflowDefinitionException containing only SFE-AUTH-DEADLINE-001 with second/first authored locations.
expectedRed: The exact deadline diagnostic is not implemented.

setup: Compile calls to Parallel, ForEach, AcquireResources, ContinueAsNew, End, or root Init from nested, branch, item, or leased builders where prohibited.
assertion: Every prohibited member is absent at compile time, including all fan-out and nested acquisition on leased builders.
expectedRed: Current provisional builders expose superseded capabilities.
